notes: Element IDs for minifig/mummy parts were assigned by visual match to the inventory page: 4613494 = mummy legs, 4613454 = mummy torso, 4613425 = mummy head, 4610956 = headdress, 4613404 = scarab shield, 4610904 = sword. Roles may be swapped.
The manual shows 3 minifigs: the rider (b1-b5) and two identical mummies (repeat). The rider is shown on the bike on the last page but this is not a build step, so no edge is given.

Some stud-to-stud placements in the pyramid (steps 6-14) are inferred from small isometric pictures; which exact brick each slope or plate sits on is approximate. The 7 tan slopes (4530678) are spread: step 1, 6, 7, 10, 11 and 14 (x2).

Bike rear box (page 6): the sub-assembly is modelled as clip plate 4521187 + bar-end plate 4579354 + trans-red round plate + two side-clip plates 4550017 + dark red plate 4539097. Placement of the 4550017 clips is approximate: one clips to the body's rear, the other holds the rifle (4523773). The dynamite 4538780 is assumed clipped to the rifle.
Step 5 on page 4: plate 4114309 (tan 2x4) is assumed to be attached under the 4x8 base plate to extend it at the front.
Wheels (hub + tire) are built 2x and attach to the frame's front and rear axles.

Page 17: the ribbed rod with gold round plate is pushed into the hole of the Technic brick 370026; the golden staff 4610762 stands on the blue plate stud (page 18 shows it as a spring-loaded shooting piece, warning about eyes).
Only catalogue types were reused where element IDs matched (4114348, 4504374, 4565320, 4523159, 3005741); others are new.
